[[File:Andris_Moon.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The slave galley ''Andris Moon'']]
A '''slave galley''' or '''spice galley''' was the largest of the [[wind rider]]s employed by the [[Sevari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sevarcos II]]. They mounted a large number of [[flashcannon]]s for an impressive broadside. The ''[[Andris Moon]]'' was a slave galley owned by the [[Spice lord|Spice Lord]] [[Cassius Nolath Rha]].
